print("type   Iterable Sequence Mapping")

    row = [isinstance(thing, kind) for kind in (Iterable, Sequence, Mapping)]
    print(f"{name:6}", *row)

        self.charge = 100

        self.charge -= amount

    def __init__(self, name):
        super().__init__()
        self.name = name

zap = Robot("Zap")
zap.use(10)
print(zap.charge)
print(isinstance(zap, Battery))
print([c.__name__ for c in Robot.__mro__])

names.py.src:
class Vault:
    def __init__(self, owner, pin):
        self.owner = owner     # public: use freely
        self._log = []         # one underscore: hands off, please
        self.__pin = pin       # two underscores: renamed

    def check(self, guess):
        self._log.append(guess)
        return guess == self.__pin

v = Vault("Pip", 1234)
print(v.check(1111), v.check(1234))
print(v._log)
print(sorted(vars(v)))

class Dog:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        self.tricks = []     # a NEW list per dog

    def learn(self, trick):
        self.tricks.append(trick)

rex = Dog("Rex")
bo = Dog("Bo")
rex.learn("sit")
bo.learn("roll over")
print("Rex knows:", rex.tricks)
print("Bo knows:", bo.tricks)
print(rex.tricks is bo.tricks)
